name: CKEditor5 Lorem Ipsum Plugin
description: A CKEditor 5 plugin that inserts Lorem Ipsum placeholder text via a toolbar dropdown.
project_description:
CKEditor5 Lorem Ipsum Plugin 
 Introduction 
 This module integrates a Lorem Ipsum plugin into CKEditor5, enabling users to easily generate and insert placeholder text (Lorem Ipsum) directly within the CKEditor5 content editor. It provides a seamless experience for quickly filling content areas with placeholder text during content creation or design.

 Features 
 Allows users to generate and insert Lorem Ipsum placeholder text with a single click.

 Requirements 
 CKEditor5
